fields.descriptionHtml:
Imagine reaching for clear water that tastes exactly as it should, carried in a reusable glass water bottle that slips easily into your day.

Why You Will Love Carrying It

  • Borosilicate glass keeps every sip pure and free of unwanted flavors.
  • Natural cork stopper seals simply while the grey silicone sleeve adds a soft grip.
  • The 550 ml size fits most bags so you stay hydrated without extra bulk.

What Is Inside

This reusable glass water bottle holds 550 ml of borosilicate glass, finished with a natural cork stopper and grey silicone sleeve, all BPA free, priced at 28 USD.

Everyday Moments It Suits

Take it to the office, on walks, or wherever a clear glass bottle with stopper belongs, remembering it is not for hot drinks or carbonated drinks.

Why It Feels Safe And Solid

BPA free materials and sturdy borosilicate glass support everyday reuse, while the compact 550 ml design travels well in most bags.

Simple Care That Lasts

The glass is dishwasher safe and you hand wash the cork to keep everything ready for the next fill.
